title: Idgham: merging with and without ghunnah: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Idgham rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 14. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Six idgham letters
points: يَرْمَلُونَ: ي ر م ل و ن
With ghunnah: ي ن م و

blocks.title: Sort into: With ghunnah (ي ن م و) / Without ghunnah (ل ر)
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: With ghunnah (ي ن م و), Without ghunnah (ل ر).
blocks.answer: With ghunnah (ي ن م و): مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ; خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ; لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ. Without ghunnah (ل ر): وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ; يَكُن لَّهُۥ; أَن رَّءَاهُ

head: Not this
This
rows: min ni'mah: a clear noon, then noon
min-ni'mah: one long humming noon, two counts

keywords.def: merging a noon sakinah or tanween into the next letter
a humming sound from the nose, held for two counts
the six idgham letters: ي ر م ل و ن

questions.q: Read «وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا» (91:7) and explain the merge.
questions.a: Tanween before و: idgham with ghunnah: wa nafsiw-wa maa sawwaahaa.

questions.q: Idgham hunt (pupil PDF): find two idgham with ghunnah and two without in Surahs 104, 111 and 112. Today's rota group recites 92:15 to 21 in turn.
Extend: write the word that holds all six idgham letters.
Stretch: why is there no idgham in «دُنْيَا»?
questions.a: Idgham only happens across two words; inside one word the noon is said clearly (izhar).
A) Idgham with ghunnah. Tanween before waw: waw is in يَنْمُو, so it merges with a hum. Without ghunnah is only ل ر; izhar is the throat letters.

questions.q: Think again: If two drops of water touch, they become one drop. What happens to a noon sakinah when it touches meem?
questions.a: It merges into the meem (idgham); a two-count hum stays because meem is a ghunnah letter.
